dct_description_sm: Modern map in sixteenth century style. Full color with fanciful illustrations. Fifth in a series of five murals by N.C. Wyeth, the originals of which adorned the walls of the National Geographic Society buildings in Washington D.C. as of 1928. The other four pictures have appeared as frontispieces in the National Geographic Magazine for March, May, July, and November, 1928.
